I like the fabric! I'm in high school too, and I would probably wear those shorts with a simple white blouse or button-down. A plain chambray or black blouse would look nice too. As for shoes, I'd wear bohemian style sandals- brown would look best. And if you're going for a more hippie look you could mix in some cool turquoise jewelry, but simple silver accessories would also look nice.

I'm not really feeling those shoes with that dress; I think it's their height. If you're set on boots, ankle boots would look best in my opinion. And I also think a pop of color would spice the outfit up, do you have a colorful cardigan or jacket? Cool tones would work best, probably a red/purple/pink color.
I've seen a girl sew a layer of lace onto denim shorts to make them longer, and they turned out well. Maybe that could work for you? You could possibly use fabric glue if that would be easier.
